settings.heading: Warranty
settings.lead: ENSŌ products are built with thoughtful engineering, quality materials and reliable performance, and they are covered accordingly.

settings.heading: What the warranty covers
settings.covered_footnote: Issues caused by defects in the product's software, materials or manufacturing process under normal use. When a valid issue is confirmed, ENSŌ EU assesses the product and provides an appropriate solution under the warranty terms.
settings.not_covered_footnote: Proper care and use are required to keep the warranty valid.

settings.heading: Sending a product back
settings.body_1: Returns are accepted within 15 days of delivery for unused items in original condition. Opened or used items are final sale. A 20% restocking fee applies to all accepted returns.
settings.body_2: Return shipping is at your cost and is not covered by ENSŌ. Before sending anything back, contact ENSŌ US support for the correct return instructions. Returns sent without prior authorization will not be accepted.
settings.note_text: Diamond pre-orders may be returned within 30 days of delivery. All other items follow the 15-day policy above.
